note: The paragraph 2 chapeau is kept in this passage so that 'shall' stays pointable. The all-hazards approach, and the aim of protecting network and information systems and their physical environment, are that shared parent qualification. They are not ten separate duties. 'At least' means the list is a minimum. This passage does not itself name essential and important entities; the chapeau refers to the measures in paragraph 1. Three subjects are named. Access control does not stand in for human resources security or asset management. Discovery hints name plausible artifacts. They are not proof that a measure is appropriate, proportionate, or in place, and they are not proof that a Member State has transposed this duty.

references.law_text:
The measures referred to in paragraph 1 shall be based on an all-hazards
approach that aims to protect network and information systems and the physical
environment of those systems from incidents, and shall include at least the
following: (i) human resources security, access control policies and asset
management;

remediation_hint: Look for human resources security, access control policies, and asset management. All three are in the point.
scope: human resources security, access control policies and asset management
